name: Status badge
summary: A glanceable lifecycle pill for a domain object — draft, published, closed, archived.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-status-badge> — the reusable form of the status-badges pattern. A coloured dot plus a text label (state is never conveyed by colour alone), `status` drives the colour via CSS on a persistent node, and the label is your slotted text. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; carries role="status" for screen readers. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin attribute wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: status
props.desc: The lifecycle state — drives the pill and dot colour

whenToUse.when: reflecting a value from a known status enum (a survey/presentation/collector's lifecycle state)
a free-form label, keyword or category chip
a count or a bare notification dot

opinion.note: Use only for a value from a real status enum — not free-form labels, counts, or notification dots (those are Tag / Badge). Always keep the text label; the dot colour is decorative and never the sole signal.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — this is the reusable component form of the status-badges pattern (parts/status-badges.guide.md): dot + text label, colour by state, role="status". Colours map to the semantic token layer (positive/warning + neutral greys). A deliberate, documented AhaSlides surface.
